title: General requirements.
officialText: Thin shell and folded-plate construction may be used for buildings or portions of buildings, as required in this section and subject to the provisions of this subchapter. The applicable provisions of the several reference standards relating to allowable stresses and the use of structural materials shall apply except as modified in this section.
